reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: no liquidated damages, stipulated penalty, minimum-volume/shortfall charge or early-termination fee is imposed on the Licensee (our side).

p0049 preserves only the Licensor's right to accrued, usage-based payments for trades actually performed — not an accelerated or stipulated sum — and p0138 imposes only return/certification obligations with no exit payment.
p0142 expressly disclaims termination damages for either party, reinforcing the absence of a Customer-payable liquidated amount.

The p0064 audit cost-shift on a >5% discrepancy is reimbursement of actual audit cost, a customary true-up rather than a penalty, so it is correctly not flagged under this rule; the Licensor-only liability cap in p0130 is properly deferred to the liability-cap rule.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; deterministic checks are empty, consistent with an unchanged rendering.
